description: This file is a shell script (.sh) that contains a series of test cases for Git's partial clone, fetch, and object filtering features. It sets up repositories, performs various clone and fetch operations with different filters, and verifies behaviors such as object filtering, partial clone consistency, and protocol handling.

methods.name: hex_unpack
methods.description: Converts bytes into their hexadecimal representation.

methods.name: intersperse
methods.description: Inserts a specified delimiter at the start and every 2 characters within a string.

methods.name: replace_packfile
methods.description: Creates a script to replace the current packfile with a specified packfile, ensuring proper protocol formatting.

methods.name: start_httpd
methods.description: Starts a local HTTP server for tests involving HTTP-based Git operations.
